Name: Guns And Roses
Author: Tyr4nTX
Description:
[b]Guns & Roses — A Gunslinger Combat Overhaul (ALPHA)[/b]Become a Gunslinger in Stardew Valley.

Start your adventure with a pistol, unlock powerful skills, complete bounty quests, upgrade your weapon at the Gunsmith, and hunt down elite enemies for high-value loot.

[b][u]IMPORTANT / HELP WANTED:[/u][/b]
I’m not an artist and this mod was built almost entirely without hand-drawn sprites.
Right now the pistol visuals (holster + shooting) are handled with a simple overlay, so it doesn’t look as clean/vanilla-like as tools such as the Pickaxe or Axe.
If you know how to integrate weapon animations properly (or want to help with sprites), please reach out — I’d love to make the pistol feel 100% native to Stardew Valley.


⚠️ [b]ALPHA WARNING:[/b] This mod is still in active development.
Expect balance issues, rough edges, and ongoing improvements — feedback is welcome!
[line]

✅ READ THIS FIRST (How to Play / First Steps)This mod can feel [b]VERY hard at the beginning[/b] — and that’s intentional for now.

However, you also become [b]extremely strong very quickly[/b] once your build starts rolling.
⭐ Step 1 — Configure the Mod BEFORE you start fighting (REQUIRED)[b]This is not “plug & play perfect” yet.[/b]
To get the best experience, you should [b]open GMCM settings early[/b] and adjust difficulty and values to your taste.
✅ [b]My personal recommended beginner setup:[/b]
[list]
[*]Difficulty: [b]Greenhorn[/b]
[*]Enemy multiplier / mob amount: [b]1[/b] (normal vanilla-like mob count)
[/list]⚠️ If you ignore the config, early game may feel unfairly punishing.
🥖 Step 2 — Bring Healing!At the start, you should always carry:
[list]
[*]Food
[*]Healing items / potions
[*]Anything that keeps you alive longer
[/list]You will need it — especially in the mines.


[line]🎯 Right Click Skills — THE MOST IMPORTANT MECHANIC

Your Gunslinger has [b]3 main builds[/b], and each build comes with its own [b]Right Click Special Ability[/b] for the pistol:
🔥 Firepower Build → [b]Burst Charge[/b]High burst damage / aggressive playstyle
🛡️ Endurance Build → [b]Iron Guard[/b]Defensive survival tool / tank-style gameplay
🌑 Dexterity Build → [b]Shadow Step[/b]Mobility / assassin-style repositioning tool
✅ How to equip a Right Click skillIn the Skill UI you will see a small selection indicator (a “little dot”/marker).
You must [b]select one Right Click skill[/b] to make it active on your pistol.
➡️ [b]Only the selected one will trigger on Right Click.[/b]
🔁 Switching Right Click skills (Build Swap Rule)You can swap your Right Click skill [b]at any time[/b], but:
⚠️ You must be [b]OUT of combat[/b]
✅ You can swap [b]8 seconds after combat ends[/b]
This is intentional so you can adapt your build without abusing instant swaps mid-fight.


[line]
🔧 Gunsmith Weapon Upgrade System (RNG Risk!)A true classic feature: [b]The Gunsmith is here.[/b]
Upgrade your pistols from:

✅ [b]+1 up to +10[/b]
✅ Each upgrade makes your weapon stronger
✅ Upgrades require special materials
⚠️ [b]RNG Upgrade System:[/b] High upgrades can be risky — things can go wrong!
Depending on your upgrade tier, the process may include:
[list]
[*]Success
[*]Failure (no progress)
[*]Downgrade
[*]Weapon destruction [i](yes, pain can happen!)[/i]
[/list]This system is designed for players who love high-stakes progression and chasing the perfect upgraded pistol.

[b]Loot-Based Gear Progression

[/b]In Guns & Roses, equipment isn’t just decoration anymore.
Armor and gear can roll [b]randomized stat bonuses[/b], turning loot into real progression and enabling different playstyles and builds.
Example stat rolls include:
[list]
[*][b]Firepower[/b]
[*][b]Dexterity[/b]
[*](more to come)
[/list]

[line]
🎬 Important Note: AI-Generated CGI ContentThis mod includes [b]CGI / cutscene visuals that are 100% AI-generated[/b].
Everything is fully fictional and created specifically for this project.

[line]
🎮 Built for Steam Deck + Full Controller Support[b]Guns & Roses was developed with Steam Deck in mind from day one.[/b]
I personally love playing on Steam Deck — so the mod is designed to be:
✅ [b]Fully controller-friendly[/b]
✅ Steam Deck focused
✅ Comfortable to play without extra hotkeys
⚠️ [b]UI Warning:[/b] Some menus and interfaces are still [b]misaligned / not perfectly polished yet[/b].
I’m aware of it — and it will be improved step-by-step.

[line]🌍 Language✅ [b]Everything is in English[/b] (UI, quests, tooltips, dialogues, config descriptions).
[line]
🔥 What is this mod about?[b]Guns & Roses[/b] is a [b]combat overhaul[/b] built around a new playstyle:
✅ You get a [b]pistol early on[/b] through a short intro event
✅ You can shoot freely ([b]no ammo system[/b])
✅ You grow stronger fast through skills, loot, and weapon upgrades
✅ The gameplay loop is built to feel like an action-RPG inside Stardew Valley
You’re not just a farmer anymore.
You’re a [b]Gunslinger[/b].

[line]
⭐ Core Features🔫 Pistol Combat[list]
[*]Start with a pistol early in the game
[*][b]No ammo required[/b]
[*]Built for controller + Steam Deck friendly gameplay flow
[/list]🧠 Skill System (10 skills already!)[list]
[*][b]10 Skills implemented[/b]
[*]Includes [b]3 Active Skills[/b] triggered via [b]Right Click[/b]
[*]Other skills are passive/proc-based for build variety
[/list]🎚️ 4 Difficulty Modes (Risk vs Reward)This mod includes [b]4 custom difficulty tiers[/b]:
[list]
[*]Enemies become harder
[*]Rewards improve with higher difficulty
[*]Progression becomes more “Diablo-like” over time
[/list][line]🧩 Quest System (Mine Quest Board)Inside the mines you’ll find a [b]Quest Tab[/b] where you can:
[list]
[*]Accept quests
[*]Complete [b]Kill Quests & Fetch Quests[/b]
[*]Turn them in for rewards
[/list]This system is already implemented.
[line]👑 Elite / Boss Enemies & Loot DropsEach area can spawn [b]tougher enemies / bosses[/b] which can drop:
[list]
[*]Gold
[*]Better loot
[*]Harder / rarer rewards
[/list][line]🧤 Loot-Based Stat SystemEquipment can roll stat bonuses such as:
[list]
[*][b]Firepower[/b]
[*][b]Dexterity[/b]
[*](more systems planned later)
[/list]This creates loot hunting and build progression.
[line]🌹 NPCs (Work in Progress)RoseRose currently acts as your entry NPC:
[list]
[*]She gives you the pistol
[*]She is [b]not fully integrated into lore yet[/b]
[*]Her story and quests will come later
[/list][line]⚠️ ALPHA Disclaimer (Very Important)This mod is [b]not fully balanced yet[/b].
Expect:
[list]
[*]rough edges
[*]difficulty spikes
[*]fast power growth
[*]experimental tuning
[/list][b]Early game is HARD — but you become VERY strong quickly.[/b]
Balancing will improve over time.

[line]
✅ Requirements / DependenciesHard Requirements[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b]
[*][b]Dynamic Dialogue Framework (TDF)[/b]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]
[/list]Highly Recommended[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]
(Recommended to tune difficulty and gameplay settings!)[/list][line]
📌 Compatibility Notes[list]
[*]Designed around [b]SVE[/b] and may not work correctly without it
[*]Built for [b]Steam Deck & controller gameplay[/b]
[*]UI polish is still in progress
[/list][line]
🛠️ Roadmap / Planned FeaturesThis mod will expand over time — and I’d love community help and feedback:
✅ UI / Steam Deck Polish[list]
[*]Fix menu alignment & layout consistency
[*]Cleaner UI spacing & scaling (especially Steam Deck)
[*]Improve overall readability and flow
[/list]🎨 Visual Improvements[list]
[*]Better sprites for skills, effects, icons
[*]Cleaner animations & combat feedback
[*]Optional VFX polish while keeping performance stable
[/list]🧠 Skills & Build Expansion[list]
[*]More skills
[*]Deeper build paths and synergies
[*]More meaningful choices in progression
[/list]⚖️ Balancing (Big Focus)[list]
[*]Better early-game tuning
[*]Smoother difficulty curve
[*]More consistent reward pacing
[*]Upgrade system tuning (risk levels, material cost, pacing)
[/list]🧩 Content Expansion[list]
[*]More quest variety & rewards
[*]More elites/boss types
[*]More loot depth (rarities, affixes, traits, etc.)
[*]More lore + full integration for Rose
[/list][line]
🤝 Community Development / Help WantedIf you want to contribute or help with:
[list]
[*]UI layout polishing
[*]sprite art / icons
[*]animations / VFX
[*]balancing feedback
[*]bug reports / testing
[/list]…please leave a comment or reach out. Every bit helps.
[line]
❤️ Credits / Thanks(Placeholder — will be expanded)
[list]
[*]Credits to creators of Prairie King Firearms von MrHatmann... Really thank you! That i can use your Pistol sprites! I did not change the name or anything just the Sprites for the overlay! Thank you very much! 
[*]Special thanks to the Stardew modding community
[/list][line]
📌 Installation[list=1]
[*]Install all requirements listed above

[*]Drop the mod folder into:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]

[*]Launch the game via SMAPI

[*](Recommended) Configure settings via [b]GMCM[/b]

[/list]
